HTTP Markdown excludes hidden elements and template text by default while preserving visible text

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig, BrowserConfig, ContentConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(browser=BrowserConfig(mode="never"), content=ContentConfig(extract_metadata=False))
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.status_code)
    print((result.markdown.content if result.markdown else None))

asyncio.run(main())
```
